title: Micro Assistant
description: Shows which counting relics and powers each card play affects - on the hovered card, and above the End Turn button.
changeNote: v0.12.0: optional always-on Setup Relics bar listing the nine run-persistent relics (counters that carry between combats); Scale Always On applies the size slider to every badge surface; don-t-do-X payoffs (Pocketwatch, Art of War, Ripple Basin, Orichalcum) now warn on a card only while the payoff is still winnable.
